subject.title: feat(memory): add excludePaths option to memorySearch config

question: Should OpenClaw support a new `agents.defaults.memorySearch.excludePaths` public setting that intentionally applies only to the builtin backend, while QMD indexing remains unaffected?
rationale: This is an additive, persistent core configuration contract rather than a repair to an established behavior; code review cannot choose whether builtin-only scope is the intended supported product boundary.

options.title: Accept builtin-only scope
options.body: Keep the configuration under the existing memory-search surface, retain the explicit QMD limitation in help and docs, and merge after narrowing the CodeQL exception.

options.title: Design a backend-consistent contract first
options.body: Pause this PR until the memory owners define whether QMD should implement the same exclusion semantics or expose a backend-specific alternative.

options.title: Route it to plugin-owned configuration
options.body: Move the setting to the memory-core owner boundary if maintainers do not want another core agent-memory configuration key.

recommendation.title: Accept builtin-only scope
recommendation.body: Keep the configuration under the existing memory-search surface, retain the explicit QMD limitation in help and docs, and merge after narrowing the CodeQL exception.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor is the only evidence-backed contact in the supplied branch history; maintainer ownership for the public configuration decision requires direct maintainer assignment.
